req_20260801_052039_eb0c.summary: One development EC2 instance appears idle and may be optimized after human review.

paths.title: Stop the idle development instance
paths.reason: The development instance has low CPU utilization and appears underused.
evidence: The resource belongs to the development environment.
steps: Confirm that there are no scheduled workloads.
pros: The instance can be started again later.
cons: The application will be unavailable while stopped.
A startup delay may occur when service is restored.

paths.title: Resize the EC2 instance
paths.reason: A smaller instance may reduce cost while keeping the service available.
evidence: The current workload may not require the existing capacity.
steps: Check the runbook for approved instance types.
pros: Reduces cost without permanently stopping the service.
cons: The smaller instance may have insufficient capacity.

paths.title: Continue monitoring before making a change
paths.reason: Additional metric history can reduce uncertainty before changing the resource.
evidence: Only 24 hours of average metric data is currently available.
steps: Collect CPU and network metrics for seven days.
Check for scheduled or periodic workloads.
Reevaluate the instance after collecting more evidence.
pros: Provides more evidence for the final decision.
cons: The existing cost continues during monitoring.
